page.overview:
Who is Drake?

Rear Admiral Drake was a Human female Starfleet flag officer in the mid-23rd century.

In 2257, Drake was consulted over holographic channels by Admiral Katrina Cornwell after she, Ambassador Sarek, and Emperor devised a plan to have the attack Qo'noS in an attempt to end the Klingon War. Drake at first sided with Rear Admiral Shukar in favor of having Discovery rejoin the remainder of the fleet and defend Earth. However, the plan to attack the Klingon homeworld was ultimately green-lit. ()

In 3195, she was listed with other luminaries of Starfleet Academy on a commemoration wall in the . ( set decoration)
